title: Assurance artifact vault and proof pipeline for SOC2/ISO automation
creator: Asha Raman
description: Build an end-to-end artifact vault and automated proof generation pipeline that captures, classifies, and serves SOC 2 and ISO 27001 artefacts tied to data residency and retention controls. The pipeline should: 1) discover control-relevant artifacts (config snapshots, ACLs, KMS logs, retention policy configs, regional deployment tags), 2) attach provenance/metadata (who/when/where), 3) produce signed proof bundles for auditors, and 4) expose curated reports and on-demand exports in the Redwood Console and via the compliance API.
acceptance_criteria: Mapping: Each SOC 2/ISO control in scope has an associated list of artifact types and a primary collector defined in the control ledger
Collectors: At least three automated collectors implemented (KMS key access logs, S3-like retention config snapshots, VPC/subnet regional tags) and running in nightly pipeline
Provenance: Every stored artifact includes immutable metadata: collector_id, timestamp, SHA256 checksum, model of residency label, and retention TTL
Proof bundles: System can generate a signed proof bundle (JSON + manifest + checksum + signature) for a control in under 90s for auditor export
Retention enforcement: Artifacts obey configured retention TTLs and are automatically pruned with a verifiable deletion log
Console UX: Compliance Console shows per-control latest artifact, last-collected time, and a one-click "Generate Auditor Package" action
API: Compliance API exposes endpoints to list artifacts by control, export proof bundles, and query provenance (with RBAC checks)
Audit trail: All proof generation events are recorded to an append-only audit stream accessible to Security and Customer Support with pagination and export
tasks: Design control ledger schema for mapping controls -> artifact types -> collectors
Implement collector: kms-access-collector (reads KMS audit logs and emits artifacts)
Implement collector: storage-retention-snapshot (captures bucket retention config and policy id)
Implement collector: infra-tag-scanner (records regional tags and tenant residency labels)
Build artifact vault service (immutable storage + metadata index)
Add signed proof bundle generator and signature key rotation plan
Console: add Compliance > Artifacts table and Generate Auditor Package flow
Compliance API endpoints and auth scopes
E2E tests + load test for nightly pipeline
Security review and key custody checklist
